title: Botol Teh Mbak Sri
subject: a young man in Ngawi who drinks bottled tea every day to fill a sack for the kampung waste bank, just to stand at the Sunday scale while Mbak Sri, who runs it, weighs plastic and writes balances in her ledger without looking up
caption: Pop Jawa ambyar band, the East Java heartbreak-pop style of the 2020s. Clean electric guitar playing a sighing lead melody, kendang ciblon groove, round bass guitar, a breathy suling bamboo flute answering each line, light live drum kit. Warm live-band sound with open room reverb and a singalong crowd feel. Male tenor with a plaintive Javanese-pop delivery and a small crack on held notes. 92 BPM, E minor. Wry, sweet, good-humoured. No autotune, no EDM drop, no trap beat, no orchestral strings, no rock distortion.
lyrics:
[Intro - suling and guitar, kendang enters]

[Verse 1]
Minggu pagi di balai RT
Mbak Sri buka timbangan
Botol plastik, kardus bekas
Dia catat di buku tulis

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku datang bawa sekarung
Isinya cuma botol teh

[Chorus]
Satu kilo, tiga ribu
Saldoku naik pelan-pelan
Mbak Sri nulis, nggak lihat aku
Pulpennya cuma kenal angka

[Verse 2]
Tetangga bawa kaleng bekas
Anak kecil bawa sedotan
Mbak Sri sabar, satu-satu
Timbang, tulis, tanda tangan

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku minum teh tiap hari
Biar karungku cepat penuh

[Chorus]
Satu kilo, tiga ribu
Saldoku sudah lima puluh
Mbak Sri senyum, akhirnya bilang
Mas, kurangi yang manis

[Outro - suling and crowd hum]
